app.title: Show HN: Buslens – where can I get to by bus? (UK)
app.author: RobinL
app.description: A web app that visualizes bus routes and allows users to find optimal bus travel routes within the UK.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run `npm install` to install dependencies.
Start the development server with `npm run dev` and verify the homepage loads.
Run the provided test suite with `npm test` and check that all tests pass.
Use a headless browser to navigate to a known bus route and confirm the correct stops are displayed.
Measure response time of the API endpoint that retrieves bus schedules and compare against a baseline.
